name: Moon's Pillow
story: Comet wants a high sleeping perch. Build a moonlit tower through the starwind.
objective: Lock 12 supported slabs above the foundation before the timer ends.
twist: Smooth wind and pulse variations test the climb; save the single magnet charge for recovery.
rule: Time 12 slab drops, alternate both slide directions, and keep enough overlap to support the tower.
controls: Space / tap: lock. U or E: spend the single magnet charge while inside the blue snap guide. Watch the wind before committing; the guide remains centred on the supported slab. Magnet locks break the perfect streak.
